This parcel is a sandbox: each person may have up to [MAX] prims here and objects are returned after [MINUTES] minutes. You have [COUNT] prims here.
This parcel is a sandbox: each person may have up to [MAX] prims here. Auto return is off (About Land > Objects). You have [COUNT] prims here.
This parcel is a sandbox. You manage it, so the limit does not apply to you (you have [COUNT] prims here).
panel.text: Lets people build here within limits: each person may have only so many prims on this parcel, and their objects are returned to them after the minutes you set. A rez that would go over the limit is refused, and the person is told why. You, members of the parcel's group with the Land Options power, and estate managers are not limited.

panel.text: Only you and your group can build here now. To open the sandbox to everyone, tick "Everyone" under Build on the Options tab.
